details:
Summary:

I'm unable to join instances hosted by (or containing) a specific subset of friends, regardless of world, instance type (Public or Friends/Friends+), or whether that friend is the instance master or not. This issue has been present for a very long time — likely over a year, possibly a year and a half — and has persisted across multiple VRChat client updates, hardware upgrades, and network changes on my end during that entire period. My own instances always work fine in every region. Other users can join the same instances without issue when I cannot.

Symptom:

Client connects to the Photon game server successfully, world downloads and instantiates normally, then hangs indefinitely right after the "Warming shaders for world mirrors" step. After ~22–23 seconds, the client disconnects with ClientTimeout. Performance stats logged at disconnect show player_count: 1 and visible_player_count: 1 — meaning the other player(s) already in the room never actually synced to my client at any point during the join attempt.

Representative log excerpt:

Room instantiate took 6.079086s

Warming shaders for world mirrors

[... ~22-23s of silence, no further events ...]

OnLeftRoom

OnDisconnected: ClientTimeout

{{ NameServerAddress: 'ns.photonengine.io:27000', MasterServerAddress: 'gcams1183.exitgames.com:27001', GameServerAddress: '80.93.214.112:27002', Code: 'ClientTimeout', State: 'Disconnected', Time: '...' }}

Disconnected: ClientTimeout with Reason: 

Connection summary: SCS v0 UDP SocketErrorCode: 0 WinSock

World example: wrld_ebfa74e9-486b-4b1b-9f86-76ed982fc454 ("somewhere after midnight"), instance 88914~hidden. Same pattern also reproduced with other worlds and other affected friends.

What I have ruled out through testing:

1. Account: reproduced on my main account AND a brand-new account (mutual friends confirmed on both)

2. Device: reproduced on two completely different machines (desktop RTX 4070 Ti Super / 7950X3D, and laptop RTX 4060M / i7-13620H (both using windows))

3. Network: reproduced across multiple cities (Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Gelendzhik) and multiple ISPs

4. VPN: reproduced with no VPN, and with multiple different VPN providers/servers

5. DPI circumvention tools: reproduced with Zapret both active and fully closed (not just disabled profile)

6. Photon server region: my own instances work on every region without issue — only joining specific people's instances fails

7. Instance state: reproduced both on long-running instances and on instances freshly created seconds before I joined

8. Master client role: reproduced whether the "unjoinable" friend is the instance master or just a regular occupant

9. Instance privacy type: reproduced in both Friends/Friends+ instances (where I am confirmed mutual friends with the owner) and in Public instances

10. World-specific bug: reproduced across multiple different worlds with different affected friends, so not tied to one world's Udon logic

11. Client-side settings: mirrors disabled, avatar auto-load disabled, graphics quality lowered — no effect on the outcome

12. Confirmed other users (not me) can join the exact same instance of the exact same friend without any issue at the same time

Pattern that remains constant:

The failure appears to be specific to the pairing between my client (regardless of account/device/network) and specific individual users' presence data, rather than to any environmental factor on my end. It is not a general connectivity issue since I can create and join my own instances everywhere without any problem.

Request:

Could someone on the networking/Photon team check server-side logs for GameServerAddress 80.93.214.112:27002 / MasterServerAddress gcams1183.exitgames.com:27001 around the timestamps in the attached logs, to see what's happening on the room/actor-sync side when my client attempts to join? I'm happy to provide my UserID, the affected friends' UserIDs, and additional full output logs (multiple sessions attached) if that helps investigation. I can also arrange for one of the affected friends to submit their own client log from the same session if that would be useful for cross-referencing both sides of the same join attempt.

Additional affected worlds:

The same failure pattern (hang after "Warming shaders for world mirrors" → ClientTimeout after ~22-23s) has also been observed in several other unrelated worlds, including Who say what, Fish! and Пятёрочка (Pyaterochka), among others — seemingly without any pattern tying it to a specific world. This further supports that the issue is not caused by any single world's Udon logic, but is tied to specific pairs of users regardless of which world they're in.

This message was written with the help of AI tools, in order to quickly produce a detailed report from the full troubleshooting conversation, as well as to translate the message into English.
title: Consistent ClientTimeout disconnect when joining specific friends' instances (any world, any instance type) — reproduced across 2 accounts, 2 devices, multiple networks/VPNs
